title: AI is a tool and using it well takes skill
script:
The blog yyhh.org argues AI models are tools, not autonomous thinkers.
Effective usage requires you to stop expecting the software to perform all the thinking.
You must treat the interface as a leverage point to amplify your own unique intent.
The author, Yihui Xie, notes that better output depends on the effort in your instructions.
Instead of waiting for perfect answers, you must guide the internal logic of the response.
This shift in perspective is the biggest factor in improving your daily professional results.
Would you classify your current interaction with these models as active or passive?
